model_annotation: This plot illustrates the sharpness composition for a ViT model on ImageNet1k across various training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 37700, with numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 7540. The y-axis, labeled "Sharpness composition," employs a symmetric logarithmic scale to display both positive and negative values, featuring tick labels at $-10^0$, $-10^{-1}$, 0, $10^{-1}$, and $10^0$; a thin, solid black horizontal line represents the zero mark. The plot contains three data series, all depicted as solid lines without markers. The blue line begins exactly at 0 at 0 training steps, rises sharply to peak near $10^0$ before the 7540-step mark, and then exhibits a very gradual decline across the remainder of the x-axis, ending just below $10^0$ at 37700 steps. The orange line starts at approximately $10^0$ at 0 steps, drops rapidly to a local minimum around $6 \times 10^{-1}$ early in the training process, and subsequently follows a slow, steady upward trend to end near $10^0$ at 37700 steps. The brown line begins at 0 at 0 steps, decreases steeply to approach $-10^0$ before 7540 steps, and maintains a relatively steady, slightly fluctuating trend near $-10^0$ throughout the middle of the plot, eventually ending slightly above $-10^0$ at 37700 steps.
